entries.title: Compress
entries.summary: An offline image compressor with a before/after slider, batch queue and per-file savings. No account, no uploads, no internet permission.
entries.built: The whole app: picker flow, preview pipeline, encoder retry loop, queue management, sharing, launcher icon and the settings screen.

entries.title: Icons browser
entries.summary: All 1,864 glyphs from two free sets in one filterable grid, one tap each to copy the SVG, with a textarea fallback for browsers that block the clipboard.
entries.built: The fetch pipeline, the recolouring to currentColor, the grid and clipboard handling, and the JSON the phone app will read.
entries.stack: Vanilla JavaScript, one HTML file, Python fetch script

entries.title: This site
entries.summary: The shelf: catalogs for the tools, icons, fonts and work, all built from the same measurements as the apps and all readable as JSON.
entries.built: The measured layout, one shared stylesheet, the JSON builder that re-measures every shipped file, and the render gallery.
entries.stack: Hand-written HTML and CSS, Python build steps, static hosting
